name: Scotch Game
title: Scotch Game
blurb: Open the centre at once with d4.
summary: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4: open the centre straight away; against 4...Nf6 swap on c6 and push e5.
source: Lichess database (blitz,rapid,classical; ratings 1000-1900 (Lichess database, 2014-15)) + Stockfish depth 13

children.note: Guard the d4 knight and offer a bishop swap.
Chase the d5 knight out of the centre.
Pin the e5 pawn to your queen; it is safe now.
Kick the f6 knight and grab space.
Swap knights to double Black's pawns, then push e5.
